methods.label: Count distinct endpoint pairs
methods.explanation: Every pair of points determines a line segment. There are \(4\times3\div2=6\) in total: \(AB\), \(AC\), \(AD\), \(BC\), \(BD\), and \(CD\).
methods.levelReason: The six unordered endpoint pairs are explicitly listed. The cnm_h236 assignment uses only its small unordered-selection criterion; no general combination formula or notation is required.
